name: 每周研究博客：当期推进巡检与内容恢复
description: 仅周五、周日20:15至22:15每小时巡检当期；等待在途任务，补启动漏跑任务，有界修复保存稿并独立复核。非发布日不催稿、不补发。每期最多两次恢复，保留限流与熔断。

workflow.policy: Scope is the current Friday/Sunday blog edition only; non-publication days must skip before inspection/enqueue/model calls. Reuse cached evidence; fresh factual and bilingual final review are mandatory. Count all writer/watchdog calls, including failures. Do not reset denials, restart services, change code/config/credentials, fetch sources through Codex, or alter other tasks. Missing upstream can be enqueued once under its existing collection policy.
